formula.ascii: Table admission, after the cutoff search of one source row: isIncluded = isFiniteBits(cost) && cost >= 0, where cost is the f32 reachability fixpoint searched with the cost limit. Unreached nodes are +Infinity and are not stored; the source itself is stored at cost 0. Included targets are packed in ascending node order by an inclusive scan, so slot order is fixed; entries past the capacity are dropped and reported by the overflow status. This is the admission rule, not a second shortest-path formula.
